## Overview（原文）

The SmartByte
LT-IS6528XG-4XS16GX8GC-U-D
is the highly reliable managed industrial Ethernet switch with 16-port 100/1000Base-X SFP, 8-port gigabit RJ45/SFP Combo and 4-port 1G/2.5G/10GBase-X SFP+. In normal operation, it is a L3 managed Ethernet switch. It supports ERPS redundant network and the self-recovery mechanism less than 20ms on full load which allows you to scheme a reliable Ethernet network by building a redundant ring topology as your back-up solution. It also supports DI/DO/RS485, DHCP server, DHCP relay, IPv4/IPv6 static routing and dynamic routing protocols like
RIP, OSPFv2, BGP4, IS-IS,
robust Layer 2 management and secure functions, which can help users expand their networks quickly and efficiently.
LT-IS6528XG-4XS16GX8GC-U-D
is the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, including redundant AC+DC, DC+DC and AC+AC power design with polarity reverse protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation
temperature from -40°C to 80°C as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability. It is the best choice for heavy
industrial factory,
transportation, oil & gas, chemical,
IP Surveillance
and processing automation area
where environmental conditions are harsh and critical
.

## Features（原文）

- 16*100/1000Base-X SFP, 8*1000Base Combo, 4*1G/2.5G/10GBase-X SFP+
- Redundant
- AC+DC, AC+AC, DC+DC power input w
- ith polarity reverse/over-current protection
- Support DI/DO/RS485 and USB one key configuration & upgrading
- Layer 3 features: Support IPv4/IPv6 static routing, DHCP server, DHCP relay;
- Support ECMP, VRRP,
- RIP, OSPF, BGP4, IS-IS; 13K routing entries
- Layer 2 features: VLAN/GVRP/QinQ/SPAN/RSPAN/STP, RSTP, MSTP/DHCP/Multicast/ACL
- QoS/LLDP/802.1X/AAA/Loop Detect/Dying Gasp/SFP DDM/IPV6 managem
- ent/Dual Stack
- /sFlow/W
- eb/SNMP/MQTT/Telnet/TFTP/Web upgrading
- Support G.8032 ERPS protocol,
- recovery time ≤20ms
- Support 6KV surge protection and ESD: Air-15kV, Contact-8kV Protection
- IP40 fan-less and rack-mount hardware design
- Operation temperature: -40 ℃ ~+ 80℃
